## What to build
Continue build "Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX" (phone-connect-small-android-companion) — Phase 2, model Opus.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-15 13:36):
"We're gonna build phone connect. Plug in, and it's gonna contain these features. Approval page, add it. Monitor yes. Voice commands get rid of it, it's buggy. Notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection gone. AI assistant and agent manager kill it, merge everything into the assistant in the console. Walkthrough video kill it. Open pages on phone keep it. Notifications keep it. Audio recorder, remove it out of console and put the whole thing in the phone app. Wake word listener kill it. Do we need a whole console app?"
This phase downgrades Fable → Opus: fine, no approval needed (it is recorded when you tick its first step).
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Branch: claude/phone-connect-small-android-companion · PR #712
Steps in this phase (31 left, ~4.8 h):
[ ] s4 (~10 min) Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Mark each as kept and ported, merged into the console AI Assistant, or dropped. Commit it as the removal list.
[ ] s5 (~8 min) Scaffold the phone-connect console plugin: plugin.json (builtWith Opus, description, lifecycle dataDir, uiEditor none), install.mjs and uninstall.mjs, a README and a notify.json declaring the FYI, fix-update, alert and approval notification types.
[ ] s6 (~10 min) Build the server device registry and pairing routes on the core: pair code issue/claim, device list/get/revoke, heartbeat/online state. Uses the hub session for sign-in, and only Brett's own session can approve a pairing (personOnly).
[ ] s7 (~10 min) Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.
[ ] s8 (~10 min) Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
[ ] s9 (~8 min) Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
[ ] s10 (~10 min) Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.
[ ] s11 (~8 min) Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.
[ ] s12 (~10 min) Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
[ ] s13 (~8 min) Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.
[ ] s14 (~10 min) Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
[ ] s15 (~10 min) Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.
[ ] s16 (~10 min) API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.
[ ] s17 (~10 min) Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35). NO app screens or tabs (Brett 08:37): only a one-time sign-in/permissions page (incl. 'display over other apps'). Everything visible is the OVERLAY: a floating always-on-top toolbar (from build amberx-floating-toolbar-always-on-top-mic-approvals-build-status) that collapses to a small draggable button (remembers spot and state, badge count), and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that you can act on in place (approve or deny right from the popup). Themed live by the console's skin and theme tokens (Axf.colors/type/space/shapes) with no new APK. Split into more steps if needed.
[ ] s18 (~10 min) Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.
[ ] s19 (~10 min) Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).

Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.

First rule: every plugin gets a home card, made by the VPS. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

steps.text: Write the reference core for the contract: validators for the device record and command envelope, and the pairing state machine (unpaired → pending → paired → revoked). Add golden fixtures.
steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. Write the migration script with a dry run.
steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Mark each as kept and ported, merged into the console AI Assistant, or dropped. Commit it as the removal list.

Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35). NO app screens or tabs (Brett 08:37): only a one-time sign-in/permissions page (incl. 'display over other apps'). Everything visible is the OVERLAY: a floating always-on-top toolbar (from build amberx-floating-toolbar-always-on-top-mic-approvals-build-status) that collapses to a small draggable button (remembers spot and state, badge count), and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that you can act on in place (approve or deny right from the popup). Themed live by the console's skin and theme tokens (Axf.colors/type/space/shapes) with no new APK. Split into more steps if needed.
Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

NO phone Settings tab. Instead, in the CONSOLE plugin, build an Overlay settings screen synced live to the phone: (1) a toolbar editor (reuse the framework toolbar/widget editor) to add, remove and reorder buttons and widgets, pick icons, set labels and actions (open a console page, approve, recorder, notifications, build status); (2) settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): position (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide from top, burst from the middle, circle reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound or vibrate, and opacity; (3) toolbar and button: size, shape, edge snapping, auto-collapse; (4) paired device, Monitor on/off, recorder mic opt-in. Live phone preview, presets, full API parity. The phone just applies the synced config. Split into more steps if needed.

CI: build the Phone Connect APK in .github/workflows/android.yml (artifact phone-connect-debug.apk), add the app to conform checks and the shared-assets list if needed, and update the Android-on-hold exception to name Phone Connect in place of AmberX.
Merge AmberX's phone AI assistant and agent manager into the console AI Assistant: carry over anything it has that the console assistant lacks (per the inventory), or note it as covered.

Remove the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic: run uninstall.mjs --all, delete the folder and its lifecycle-marked doc lines, pass plugin-lifecycle check --after-uninstall, and shift the help ratchet.
Remove the emptied output-recorder plugin (uninstall.mjs --all, lifecycle check), leaving only the aliases in phone-connect.

Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

Retirement gate script: verify Phone Connect is installed and working (device paired, heartbeat online, a test notify acked, open_url acked, recorder status answers). Retirement below runs only if it passes, otherwise it is recorded as waiting on Brett's phone.

Retire AmberX after the gate: delete apps/amberx-droid and its manifest, drop it from shared-assets, the rules and the CI APK job, and remove the amberx.amberxai.com deploy (Coolify app and DNS record logged in the DNS log) and the axHub amberx device as veto calls with reasons. Write a decision in memory/decisions.md.

Tests, report and landing: run the full check sweep, write _claude/builds/reports/phone-connect-small-android-companion.md (removal list, API reach for each feature: deep link / REST / MCP / CLI / voice, aliases, gaps), add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating how each feature is reached and that UI Review is waiting, link it with builds-live, and land it with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. steps.text: Find the axf-data service from PR #704 (grep data-store@1) and write the Postgres DDL for the builds store: builds, build_steps, build_origins, build_journal (append-only, rev per build) and build_history tables with keys, indexes and FKs. Commit as the first migration file.
steps.why: Schema design for the main data model every build tool reads

steps.text: DDL for notes, settings (key, scope, jsonb value, updated_at, last-save-wins per key) and planner items (control@1 planner targets) as real columns, not JSON copies. Commit.
steps.why: Schema design for shared settings and planner data used across apps

steps.text: DDL for UI reviews (ui-review-item@1, ui-review-group@1, ui-choices@1 options), the feature store and the Shipped features ledger (feature-ledger@1 + deploy-log@1). Columns follow framework/schemas/ui-review.json and the ledger schema. Commit.
steps.why: Turns existing cross-app record schemas into table design

steps.text: DDL for chats (session@1: sessions + messages) and the API/control registry: a control_targets table (address, plugin, kind, label, actions, settings, registered_at) that replaces apps/console-web/src/control/inventory.json. Commit.
steps.why: Schema design for the control@1 registry that every app's API addresses depend on

steps.text: data-store@1 backend seam: define the backend interface (sqlite | postgres) so callers keep the same API. Update the data-store spec and fixture so both backends must give the same results. Record the Android twin as a deferred gap in PORTING.md.
steps.why: Cross-port data-store@1 contract and its conformance fixture

steps.text: Design the migration (data-migration plan in the spec): backup SQLite + blobs first, copy domain by domain, count and checksum checks, shadow mode (dual write, compare reads, log mismatches), cutover switch and rollback. Never delete the SQLite source. Doc + state machine constants.
steps.why: Migration design for the store every build uses; data loss isn't allowed

steps.text: Control registry generation contract: control_targets is filled from each plugin's registered targets (framework controls + data-axf-target) at build/register time. inventory.json becomes a generated export that nobody edits by hand. Update check-console-control.mjs to read the generated source.
steps.why: Changes how every app's UI targets get registered across the console and plugins

steps.text: Postgres container for Coolify: compose/Dockerfile on a private network only (no public port), a persistent volume, env vars for credentials (none in the repo) and a healthcheck. Add install helpers to the deploy scripts.
Daily backups: a pg_dump cron into ~/hub/data/axf-data/backups with retention, plus restore and verify-backup scripts. Commit.
Systems check: a health@1 check for Postgres (reachable, migrations at head, last backup under 26 h) with auto-fix (restart the container, run a backup now) and a banner item when it fails.
Postgres backend part 1: connection pool, migration runner (applies the pg/migrations folder) and builds store + journal + history reads and writes behind data-store@1.
Postgres backend part 2: notes, settings (per-key merge, last save wins) and planner items.
Postgres backend part 3: UI reviews, feature store, Shipped features ledger and deploy log.
Postgres backend part 4: chats and control_targets (upsert per plugin, remove targets on plugin uninstall).
Migration tool part 1: `migrate backup` (SQLite file + blobs to a timestamped folder, checksummed) and `migrate copy builds` (builds, steps, origins, journal, history), idempotent and resumable.
Migration tool part 2: copy every other domain, then `migrate verify` (row counts + per-domain checksums, SQLite vs Postgres) writing a JSON report. A failed check stops the migration.
Shadow mode: writes go to both backends, reads compare (SQLite stays the answer), mismatches are logged with counts, and a mismatch raises a systems-check item.

Cutover and rollback: a backend setting (sqlite | shadow | postgres) with guards. Cutover only after a clean verify and zero shadow mismatches for a set window. Rollback goes back to SQLite and copies back writes made since cutover.

Control inventory generator: build control_targets from every plugin's registered targets, write the inventory.json export, and make CI fail on a hand edit (generated header + hash check). Run it and commit the regenerated export.

API part 1, REST + MCP: status (backend, stage, counts per table, shadow mismatches, last backup), actions (backup now, verify, shadow on/off, cutover, rollback; destructive ones need confirm) and the backend setting as a console-control address.

API part 2, CLI + voice: `axf data status|backup|verify|shadow|cutover|rollback`, AmberX voice actions mapped to the same calls, and a deep link `view:settings/tab:settings.tabs=plugins` → the Data sub-tab for console_show.

Console UI: the Data sub-tab under Settings → Plugins shows the backend, migration stage, table counts, backups and shadow mismatches, with action buttons. Framework controls and tokens only, targets registered via data-axf-target.
UI Review: shoot desktop + phone shots of 3 options for the Data panel layout (each a settings asset in plugins/<owner>/assets/settings/) and submit them with review.mjs --choices.
Tests part 1: run the data-store@1 conformance fixture against SQLite and against a throwaway Postgres container (agent-slots heavy). Both must give the same results.
Tests part 2: migration end to end on a copy of real data (backup, copy, verify counts and checksums), shadow mismatch detection, cutover guards and rollback losing nothing.
Tests part 3: control inventory generation (deterministic output, a hand edit fails CI) and the API parity check (REST = MCP = CLI = voice for status and actions).

VPS run: deploy the Postgres container through a veto call, run backup → migrate → verify, and switch to shadow mode. Cutover stays off until the PR lands and shadow has been clean for the set window. Record the counts in the report notes.
Help and catalog: plugin help, descriptions for new CLI/commands/assets (glossary-index --check), Shipped features ledger rows, catalog/status.json + tracker.mjs, STATUS.md lines.

Final: run every check (validate, tracker --check, check-console-control, check-theme/controls/toolbars, data-store tests), write the report _claude/builds/reports/axf-data-postgres-real-tables-own.md (stages, counts, how each feature is reached by deep link/REST/MCP/CLI/voice), add a THREADS.md row, open the PR, link it with builds-live.mjs and add it to the merge queue as one entry.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.

after.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
after.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

steps.why: New cross-app protocol contract between the console, axHub and the Android companion

steps.text: Write the reference core for the contract: validators for the device record and command envelope, and the pairing state machine (unpaired → pending → paired → revoked). Add golden fixtures.
steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. Write the migration script with a dry run.
steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Mark each as kept and ported, merged into the console AI Assistant, or dropped. Commit it as the removal list.

Scaffold the phone-connect console plugin: plugin.json (builtWith Opus, description, lifecycle dataDir, uiEditor none), install.mjs and uninstall.mjs, a README and a notify.json declaring the FYI, fix-update, alert and approval notification types.

Build the server device registry and pairing routes on the core: pair code issue/claim, device list/get/revoke, heartbeat/online state. Uses the hub session for sign-in, and only Brett's own session can approve a pairing (personOnly).

Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35). NO app screens or tabs (Brett 08:37): only a one-time sign-in/permissions page (incl. 'display over other apps'). Everything visible is the OVERLAY: a floating always-on-top toolbar (from build amberx-floating-toolbar-always-on-top-mic-approvals-build-status) that collapses to a small draggable button (remembers spot and state, badge count), and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that you can act on in place (approve or deny right from the popup). Themed live by the console's skin and theme tokens (Axf.colors/type/space/shapes) with no new APK. Split into more steps if needed.
Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

NO phone Settings tab. Instead, in the CONSOLE plugin, build an Overlay settings screen synced live to the phone: (1) a toolbar editor (reuse the framework toolbar/widget editor) to add, remove and reorder buttons and widgets, pick icons, set labels and actions (open a console page, approve, recorder, notifications, build status); (2) settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): position (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide from top, burst from the middle, circle reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound or vibrate, and opacity; (3) toolbar and button: size, shape, edge snapping, auto-collapse; (4) paired device, Monitor on/off, recorder mic opt-in. Live phone preview, presets, full API parity. The phone just applies the synced config. Split into more steps if needed.

CI: build the Phone Connect APK in .github/workflows/android.yml (artifact phone-connect-debug.apk), add the app to conform checks and the shared-assets list if needed, and update the Android-on-hold exception to name Phone Connect in place of AmberX.
Merge AmberX's phone AI assistant and agent manager into the console AI Assistant: carry over anything it has that the console assistant lacks (per the inventory), or note it as covered.

Remove the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic: run uninstall.mjs --all, delete the folder and its lifecycle-marked doc lines, pass plugin-lifecycle check --after-uninstall, and shift the help ratchet.
Remove the emptied output-recorder plugin (uninstall.mjs --all, lifecycle check), leaving only the aliases in phone-connect.

Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

Retirement gate script: verify Phone Connect is installed and working (device paired, heartbeat online, a test notify acked, open_url acked, recorder status answers). Retirement below runs only if it passes, otherwise it is recorded as waiting on Brett's phone.

Retire AmberX after the gate: delete apps/amberx-droid and its manifest, drop it from shared-assets, the rules and the CI APK job, and remove the amberx.amberxai.com deploy (Coolify app and DNS record logged in the DNS log) and the axHub amberx device as veto calls with reasons. Write a decision in memory/decisions.md.

Tests, report and landing: run the full check sweep, write _claude/builds/reports/phone-connect-small-android-companion.md (removal list, API reach for each feature: deep link / REST / MCP / CLI / voice, aliases, gaps), add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating how each feature is reached and that UI Review is waiting, link it with builds-live, and land it with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

steps.text: Write the reference core for the contract: validators for the device record and command envelope, and the pairing state machine (unpaired → pending → paired → revoked). Add golden fixtures.
steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Themed live by the console's skin and theme tokens (Axf.colors/type/space/shapes) with no new APK. Split into more steps if needed.
Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

NO phone Settings tab. Instead, in the CONSOLE plugin, build an Overlay settings screen synced live to the phone: (1) a toolbar editor (reuse the framework toolbar/widget editor) to add, remove and reorder buttons and widgets, pick icons, set labels and actions (open a console page, approve, recorder, notifications, build status); (2) settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): position (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide from top, burst from the middle, circle reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound or vibrate, and opacity; (3) toolbar and button: size, shape, edge snapping, auto-collapse; (4) paired device, Monitor on/off, recorder mic opt-in. CI: build the Phone Connect APK in .github/workflows/android.yml (artifact phone-connect-debug.apk), add the app to conform checks and the shared-assets list if needed, and update the Android-on-hold exception to name Phone Connect in place of AmberX.
Merge AmberX's phone AI assistant and agent manager into the console AI Assistant: carry over anything it has that the console assistant lacks (per the inventory), or note it as covered.

Remove the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic: run uninstall.mjs --all, delete the folder and its lifecycle-marked doc lines, pass plugin-lifecycle check --after-uninstall, and shift the help ratchet.
Remove the emptied output-recorder plugin (uninstall.mjs --all, lifecycle check), leaving only the aliases in phone-connect.

Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

Retirement gate script: verify Phone Connect is installed and working (device paired, heartbeat online, a test notify acked, open_url acked, recorder status answers). Retirement below runs only if it passes, otherwise it is recorded as waiting on Brett's phone.

Retire AmberX after the gate: delete apps/amberx-droid and its manifest, drop it from shared-assets, the rules and the CI APK job, and remove the amberx.amberxai.com deploy (Coolify app and DNS record logged in the DNS log) and the axHub amberx device as veto calls with reasons. Tests, report and landing: run the full check sweep, write _claude/builds/reports/phone-connect-small-android-companion.md (removal list, API reach for each feature: deep link / REST / MCP / CLI / voice, aliases, gaps), add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating how each feature is reached and that UI Review is waiting, link it with builds-live, and land it with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.detail: Add a Build rules tab to the Gate & rules plugin (PR #711), with the VPS as the ONE owner and enforcer of every builder rule. 1) Inventory ALL builder rules in CLAUDE.md, the build briefs, the dispatcher prompt templates (Look/API/Checkpoints/Rules blocks), and the _claude rule docs. List every rule first and delete nothing without listing it. 2) Move them into a build-rules store on the VPS (later axf-data), served by REST and gate.* tools. 3) Each rule is marked doer = VPS or session. Mechanical rules are done by the VPS itself, before or after the build, and are removed from Claude's instructions so nothing happens twice. Examples: create the plugin home card from plugin.json and the template, the Shipped features manifest, the help stub, API-parity scaffolding, running the CI checks, tracker/THREADS rows, PR open and link, and landing one at a time. 4) Judgement rules (look and token rules, API parity design, step size) go into the session brief from the store at dispatch time and are not hardcoded in CLAUDE.md. 5) The gate checks every rule before landing; on a fail it blocks, the VPS auto-fixes what it can, and everything is logged in History. 6) The tab shows each rule with doer, on/off, edit, add, and history, with REST/MCP/CLI/voice parity. First rule: every plugin gets a home card, made by the VPS. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

API parity for the backend: gate.build_rules_* MCP tools via plugin-commands, CLI apps/console-web/plugins/gate-rules/build-rules.mjs (list|get|add|edit|on|off|history|run), voice actions build-rules.list/toggle/add/run, all four calling the same REST.
UI: a Build rules tab in the Gate & rules plugin (TabGroup on the tab-group asset): DataGrid of rules with doer, kind, phase, on/off Switch and last result; framework controls and tokens only.
UI: add/edit rule dialog (dialog asset, TextField/SelectField for doer, kind, phase, check, autofix, brief block) and a History panel per rule; toolbar with role=toolbar + aria-label.

API parity for the UI: console-control addresses (view:gate-rules/tab:build-rules, row:<rule>, setting:<rule>.enabled) via data-axf-target, console_show deep links for the tab, a rule and its history, state readable through console_control_get.

Seed the live store: run the migration into /projects/amberx-axf/_data/build-rules/ (persist.mjs data.shared entry in project.manifest.json) and make sure the runner reads it there with the repo seed as fallback.

Remove the VPS-owned mechanical rules from Claude's instructions: cut home card, Shipped features, help stub, API-parity scaffolding, CI-run, tracker/THREADS rows, PR open/link and landing text from CLAUDE.md and the _claude rule files, leaving one pointer line to the Build rules tab. Plugin tests: apps/console-web/plugins/gate-rules/test for REST/MCP/CLI parity, the home-card fixer on a plugin without a card, the gate blocking then auto-fixing, and the dispatcher brief containing the store's session rules.

Read its plugin.json, settings tabs, server routes and commands, plus push-banner land/ (land.mjs, the serial lander, merge-queue.mjs) and /etc/cron.d/axf-auto-land. Write down which file holds the gate rules and where the lander reads autoLand/autoMerge in _claude/builds/reports/auto-lander-controls-in-the-gate-plugin.md (notes section).

Find out why the auto-lander lands nothing. Run land.mjs run --dry-run (or its status) the way the cron runs it, with the same env and user. Read its recent cron log output and check the setting it reads (autoLand off since 0.7.1?), the lock file, the token broker, and the green PRs #637/#639/#633/#640/#643 (queue membership, mergeable state, CI on the pinned head). Record the root cause(s) with evidence in the report.

Fix the root cause in the lander (e.g. setting gate, env/PATH or token in the cron line, a stale lock, queue not picking up ready PRs, or the serial path never selected). Add a regression test for that exact failure next to the existing land tests. Commit.

Remove the stale 'axf-lander inactive' warning: find the health@1 check or banner source that watches the systemd unit axf-lander, which doesn't exist. Replace it with a live check on the real cron (last run age, last result), with an Auto fix that re-enables or reinstalls the cron line. Commit.

Add the lander settings to the push-banner/lander settings registry, all keys with defaults: autoLander.enabled (one On/Off that the cron reads, off = the cron run exits early with reason 'switched off') and autoLander.mode (serial | merge-queue, default serial). Wire land.mjs run to read both at the start of every run. Unit test: off skips, mode switches the path. Commit.

Lander status record: every run of land.mjs writes a run record (startedAt, finishedAt, result, mode, PR it is landing now, blocking reason from a fixed list: switched-off | queue-empty | ci-waiting | conflict | token-missing | locked | error) to the plugin's data dir as an append-only runs log plus status.json, trimmed to the last N runs. Test the reasons. Commit.

Landing line actions in the lander core: list (ordered, one at a time, with each PR's build, CI and conflict state), move up/down, skip (with reason, remembered until removed), land now (puts it at the head and starts a run under the lock). Reuse land.mjs queue list|add|remove|move where it exists. Tests for order and skip. Commit.

REST routes in the gate plugin's server for the lander: GET status, GET line, GET runs, POST enabled, POST mode, POST line/move, POST line/skip, POST line/land-now. Each one calls the push-banner core through a capability service (plugin_services, no folder imports), and land-now/skip carry confirm. Python route tests. Commit.

Gate plugin UI part 1: add an 'Auto-lander' tab (TabGroup asset row, settings id) with a big On/Off Switch, a mode SegmentedControl-as-setting (serial/merge queue) and a live status card (last run time, result, what's landing now, why it's not landing). Framework controls and --fx-* tokens only, each control registered with data-axf-target. Commit.

Gate plugin UI part 2: the landing line as a framework DataGrid (position, PR, build, CI, state) with row toolbar Move up / Skip / Land now (role=toolbar, aria-label, tap-confirm, Land now confirm) and a Recent runs grid below it. Rows get addresses row:<pr>. Commit.

API part for the tab: console-control addresses (view:…/tab:…=auto-lander, setting:autoLander.enabled, setting:autoLander.mode, row:<pr>/action:move-up|skip|land-now) so console_show/console_open deep-link to it, plus control@1 targets appended at the end. MCP plugin-commands for status/line/runs/enable/mode/move/skip/land-now come from the routes. check-console-control and check-control pass. Commit.

CLI and voice: `axf lander status|line|runs|on|off|mode <serial|queue>|move|skip|land-now` (same core calls), and AmberX voice actions/intents 'turn on/off the auto lander', 'what's landing', 'why isn't it landing', 'land <PR> now'. Each maps to the same commands. Tests that CLI, REST and MCP give the same results. Commit.

Conformance and docs: run check-theme, check-controls, check-toolbars, check-chrome-assets and plugin-lifecycle check (fix any findings, add lifecycle markers). Add help entries for the tab and commands, plugin.json descriptions for the glossary, and an update of the plugin README. Commit.

Land it live: install the fixed cron on the VPS (veto call), switch the lander on, and check that a run lands the green console PRs (#637/#639/#633/#640/#643) or names the exact blocking reason. Record the before/after in the report.

UI Review: desktop and phone shots of the Auto-lander tab with 3 options as assets (choices JSON), submitted with review.mjs submit and the group named after the build. Shipped features ledger entry and an axf_deploy_log line.

Final: run all the tests (lander tests, plugin route tests, check-console-control, check-control, the theme/toolbar checks, catalog --check, tracker --check). Finish the report _claude/builds/reports/auto-lander-controls-in-the-gate-plugin.md (root cause, fix, API map REST/MCP/CLI/voice/deep link). Add the THREADS.md row, push the branch, open the PR with the API section and the UI Review note, and link it with builds-live.mjs link.

before.title: Build rules tab in Gate & rules: VPS owns and enforces all builder rules
before.detail: Add a Build rules tab to the Gate & rules plugin (PR #711), with the VPS as the ONE owner and enforcer of every builder rule. 1) Inventory ALL builder rules in CLAUDE.md, the build briefs, the dispatcher prompt templates (Look/API/Checkpoints/Rules blocks), and the _claude rule docs. List every rule first and delete nothing without listing it. 2) Move them into a build-rules store on the VPS (later axf-data), served by REST and gate.* tools. 3) Each rule is marked doer = VPS or session. Mechanical rules are done by the VPS itself, before or after the build, and are removed from Claude's instructions so nothing happens twice. Examples: create the plugin home card from plugin.json and the template, the Shipped features manifest, the help stub, API-parity scaffolding, running the CI checks, tracker/THREADS rows, PR open and link, and landing one at a time. 4) Judgement rules (look and token rules, API parity design, step size) go into the session brief from the store at dispatch time and are not hardcoded in CLAUDE.md. 5) The gate checks every rule before landing; on a fail it blocks, the VPS auto-fixes what it can, and everything is logged in History. 6) The tab shows each rule with doer, on/off, edit, add, and history, with REST/MCP/CLI/voice parity. First rule: every plugin gets a home card, made by the VPS. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.title: Console app: wake-word voice listener, voice approvals, every console command by voice
before.detail:
Voice control for the console Android app (wrapper, parts 1-4), working offline where possible.
- Always-on wake-word listener, with a wake phrase Brett sets in Settings (several allowed). Runs on-device (offline engine, e.g. Vosk/whisper.cpp + a local intent matcher), with a mic-on indicator and an off switch.
- After the wake phrase the app answers out loud ('What's up?') and listens for a command.
- Voice approvals: 'approve' reads pending approvals one at a time (who asked, what it does); Brett says approve, deny, skip or details. 'Approve all pending' and 'deny all' ask for one spoken confirm. Works from the floating overlay and the lock screen.
- Settings by voice, e.g. 'change the veto timer to two hours' (the axHub veto countdown, so he has that long to veto something before it runs/builds), with the value read back.
- Command catalog: every console action, plugin command, control@1 target and pipeline gets a voice entry, built from the API registry so new plugins appear automatically. Multi-field actions run as a spoken wizard that asks for each missing field ('create a new project' -> 'name?' -> 'Gizmo Johnson' -> confirm). Covers projects, builds/pipelines (file, split, prioritise, land, stop), approvals, settings, tokens/skins, notes/tasks, navigation.
- A Voice commands screen lists every command and its phrasings, searchable, with custom phrases Brett adds.
- Destructive commands always need a spoken confirm.
- Full API parity. Tests, help, Shipped features.

This phase upgrades Opus → Fable: no approval needed (Fable upgrades need my approval is off); it is recorded when you tick its first step.
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 30 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.

API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. Collector 2, main: scan origin/main without a checkout (git ls-tree / git show) for plugin.json ids, names and descriptions, CLI headers, files and settings keys (plugin settings schemas, Claude settings, build-options) into candidates.

Collector 3, live state: read each matched plugin's and the lander's live settings (on/off, since when from the settings history), lander-state@1 and the tail of its log, so the verdict can say 'exists, off since Nov 4, switch X'.

CLI framework/cli/dup-gate.mjs: check <build-id> | check --title --said, override <build-id> --reason, history, explain <verdict-id>. Plain Node with no Claude call. Exit 4 = blocked. Prints the phone-readable answer: what exists, where, on/off, the fix, the score.

Gate History: append every verdict (blocked, passed, overridden) to the gate's history store with the build id, matches, scores, who overrode it and how (tap or voice). Reuse the gate plugin's history writer.
Register 'duplicate-gate' as a build-rules@1 'before' rule (doer VPS, enabled, runs on file, queue and split) in the default rule set. Regenerate the gate-rules fixture.

Hook the gate into intake: orchestrator add, MCP pending_change add and Plan Studio 'Turn into a build' run dup-gate before writing the store. Blocked = no build record, the verdict is returned instead. Override flag passes through.

Hook the gate into the pipeline: pipeline.mjs intake (before split) and queue (before Pending → Queue) call dup-gate. A blocked build stays in Pending, holding the verdict and a 'build it anyway' action.

Console UI: a Blocked card in Builds → Gate & rules → Gate History and on the Pending row. Saves are per key, and when two of them save the same key the last save wins (`SettingsRegistry.set` merges into what storage holds now, so a save never reverts other keys). Every app's Settings → Plugins tab lists its libraries from the same engine; Android ships `PluginManagerModule` (axf-devtools). Links in menus are runtime contributions (`AxfWebLibrary.contextMenu`, `rt.addContextItems`), never edits to a context-menu asset.

Hosts mark what they embed (`EmbedEngine.userAgentSuffix` on a WebView's user agent, or `embedUrl` → `?axf-embed=<host>`); guests detect it (`rt.embedded`, automatic on the web) and apply the hide engine's forced layer, never touching the user's own saved choice. Replaces the archived context-menu-plugin-ai-generated-slim.
- New console plugin 'Context menus', integrated with the UI Manager (its menus show there per element/zone).
- ONE TRUE SOURCE: every context menu definition is stored on axHub (not local), as context-menu@1 assets, readable and writable by every plugin and app through the hub API. Plugins register the actions/hooks they offer; menus reference them.
- The plugin lists every context menu in the app (per zone/element/page, with its parent app, plugin or page), searchable, with preview, edit and Restore per row, snapshots and restore like skins.
- AI generation (needs Claude; greyed out with a clear error when the Claude badge isn't green): generate the context menus for the whole app at a chosen level. BEGINNER: a few big, obvious actions. AMATEUR: common actions. PRO: full working set grouped. ADVANCED CODER: meticulous map of every zone with deep actions (tokens, API, inspect, copy ids, run commands). Higher levels map the app more meticulously. Menus are slim by default (no wasted space, rarely used items folded away). The user picks the level, and it can differ per app/page.
- Preview before applying. Full API and voice ('generate pro context menus'). Tests, help, Shipped features. Fable for the context-menu@1 schema and the hub source.

New messages are spoken aloud in order as they arrive; mute, volume, 'only my mentions' and 'summaries only' modes; queue so voices don't overlap. Works in the console and the AmberX Android app (background audio, earbuds). Full API and voice ('turn on group chat audio', 'mute Whiskers'). Token-driven UI. Tests desktop and phone.

- Console sizes are tokens (Oct 17 2026): `console.css` and the console views use `--fx-space`, `--fx-font-size`, `--fx-radius-*` and `--fx-border-w` (exact at the default soft-studio theme, so it looks pixel-identical there); the console is held to every theme rule. Shapes stay fixed: pill radii (999px), bar/chart heights, icon sizes.
- Build options are `--switches` on every build driver (CLI, engine-rpc, serve, console API/UI, MCP), defined only in `framework/schemas/build-options.json`; each sets an asset token, and new builds default every option off.
- `framework/schemas/asset-types.json` is the single source of truth for asset types. Per-port extensions live in files like `asset-types.android.json`.
- Cross-port: change a reference engine in framework/core, then regenerate framework/spec/fixtures. No new Android or Kotlin work: record the twin as a deferred gap in framework/spec/PORTING.md.
- Android kernel is pure Kotlin (no Android imports). Platform specifics go behind kernel seams. Packages are `ai.amberx.axf.*`, Maven coordinates are `ai.amberx.axf:<module>:<version>`.
- React/TS port: the first React/TS app built on it sets the conventions, so it must stay engine-compatible for Android porting.
- `axf init` bakes `core/ react/ ui/ schemas/` into an app's `src/axf/` and records hashes in `axf.lock.json`. Change the framework, not baked copies.
- UI Review choices (Nov 7 2026): a build ships at least 3 options (ui-choices@1, `framework/core/ui-choices.mjs`), each a predicted look and an asset in `plugins/<owner>/assets/<type>/`, picked or not; Brett picks in the item's Choices tab, several in priority order where the type holds several views. Nightly console deploy: `deploy/console-nightly.mjs` (Claude settings `nightly.*`). `console.refresh`: `axf console refresh [--hard]`.
- Feature status: framework/catalog/status.json, then `node framework/cli/tracker.mjs`. Heavy steps (npm/vite builds, Playwright) go through `node framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <cmd>`.

New UI registers its targets through the framework controls or `data-axf-target`; `framework/cli/check-console-control.mjs` fails CI otherwise. Approve / deny and owner-only settings are never commands; destructive presses need `confirm`. Doc `_claude/memory/docs/console-control.md`, contract `framework/spec/CONSOLE-CONTROL.md`.
- Patches and Build Pilot are retired (Nov 3 2026): both apps and every integration with them were removed; the Dev Console and every other app run standalone. `MossesX/Build-Pilot` is archived on GitHub (read-only). Report `_claude/builds/reports/kill-patches-pilot.md`.
- No secrets: `AXF_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` are environment variables only. `.mcp.json` references `${AXF_TOKEN}`.
- He works mostly from his phone (Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra), often in Moshi (mosh) on his Hostinger VPS where Claude Code runs. Lead with the result, short paragraphs, phone-readable.
- Everything a later session needs lives in `_claude/` (this project) or `_claude/shared/` (all projects), synced with the hub. Phone, VPS, desktop and claude.ai sessions don't share chat history.
- GitHub: account `MossesX`. A new repo must exist on GitHub before a session can push to it.
- axHub (`MossesX/axHub`, https://axhub.amberxai.com/mcp) is his connector hub: use its tools (`list_services`, `describe_service`, `call`) to reach his services instead of asking for credentials.
- Pending builds: check the pending list before any build (`node framework/cli/pending.mjs`, MCP `pending_list`, console → Pending builds). "Add to the pending build list" means park it.
- Check the queue for clashes, and build related items together (Oct 21 2026, Brett): whenever any session (any machine, any surface: VPS, cloud, headless, claude.ai, console launches) is asked to build anything or to put anything in the build queue, first go through everything still to build (pending list, build queue, plan; the console's Build manager shows them all) for items that touch the same files, features or contracts, or that would later conflict with, undo or redo what is being built.
